name: Daily #status for admins
prompt:
Write a daily summary of the work to the team's #status Discord channel for admins.

1. Run `./tools/status/digest.sh`. It prints the commits that landed on main, the affected resources and the paths to rendered NUI previews in the FILES section.

2. If the script reports that nothing landed, DO NOT POST ANYTHING and stop. A daily message that invents progress on an empty day is worse than none — the admins learn to skip it.

3. Write IN BULLETS, not a paragraph. Use exactly this format:

**What's new — 8/11**
- the car catalog said you were standing too far away even when you were right next to it — fixed
- the showroom has a new camera that shows you the selected car
- after a failed start the test drive now tells you right away that it didn't work

Rules for the bullets:
   - Three to six bullets, each on ONE line, one change per bullet.
   - Keep it short so it can be skimmed. No long sentences, no intro or closing paragraph.
   - Describe what it means in the game, not what happened in the code.
   - No TASK numbers, PR numbers, branch names or file names.
   - Leave out what an admin can't notice in the game — docs, reviews and internal cleanup don't belong in the summary, even if they make up most of the commits.
   - If the commits don't show what changed for players, write one bullet saying work went into internal things. Don't make things up.

4. Save the text to a file and post it: `./tools/status/post.sh 1000000000000000001 <file> image1.png image2.png ...`

   The last line of the digest is `## PREVIEWS TO ATTACH: N`. Attach EXACTLY those N images from the FILES section — they are the whole point, and without them the post is half as good. If N is zero, check whether FILES says FAILED: that is not "nothing visual today" but a failure — say so in your reply.

   At the end of your reply always state how many previews the digest offered and how many you actually attached. If the numbers differ, say why.

   The limit is 2000 characters; the script rejects longer text.

5. Do nothing else. No commits, no deploys, no changes to the repo. If something fails, say so in your reply and leave it.
